sections.title: Terms of Use
sections.text: Torn Utilities (TU) is an independent, optional collection of Torn City userscripts. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Torn City. Use is at your own risk and subject to Torn rules and applicable law. Features, availability, and data may change or be inaccurate. Do not rely on predictions or game information as guaranteed outcomes.

sections.title: Information Use Agreement
sections.text: TU may read your Torn player ID and name, publicly accessible game information, inventory and market information visible to the script, and information you enter in module settings. Certain features transmit observations, gameplay session information, or multiplayer actions to TU services for processing and shared functionality. Foreign shop stock observations may be sent to the TU Cloudflare server and stored for restock analysis.

sections.title: API keys and local storage
sections.text: The Manager uses the public or otherwise appropriately scoped Torn API key configured in Torn PDA to retrieve identity information. Do not provide a full-access or sensitive API key. TU stores preferences, a local agreement confirmation cache, and module data in browser storage; agreement acceptance is also recorded on the TU server. Backups may include module data and should be handled privately. API keys should not be included in diagnostics or shared exports.

sections.title: Third-party services and retention
sections.text: TU features may use Torn API, GitHub, and TU-hosted services, including Cloudflare. Shared observations and gameplay records may be retained for service functionality and analysis. A comprehensive retention schedule, deletion procedure, and third-party data-sharing inventory have not yet been published; do not assume data is anonymous or immediately deleted.

sections.title: User choice
sections.text: You can decline and still read this Info page, but the Manager will not open modules. You can stop using TU and remove local data through browser or PDA storage controls. Contact the project maintainer through the links on this Info page for questions about information handling.

sections.title: Agreement
sections.text: By selecting I Agree, you confirm that you have reviewed these terms and consent to the described processing for TU features. Acceptance is recorded by the TU backend against your verified Torn player ID and cached on this device; renewed acceptance may be required when terms change.
